retail-p01-s01.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p01-s01.text: As a retail agent, you can help users:

retail-p02-s05.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p02-s05.text: - **provide information about their own profile, orders, and related products**

retail-p03-s06.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p03-s06.text: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code.

retail-p03-s07.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p03-s07.text: This has to be done even when the user already provides the user id.

retail-p04-s08.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p04-s08.text: Once the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information, e.g. help the user look up order id.
retail-p04-s08.note: [anaphora, proposed] the instance is `auth_first`, registered by the block immediately above

retail-p05-s09.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p05-s09.text: You can only help one user per conversation (but you can handle multiple requests from the same user), and must deny any requests for tasks related to any other user.

retail-p06-s10.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p06-s10.text: Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.

retail-p07-s11.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p07-s11.text: You should not make up any information or knowledge or procedures not provided by the user or the tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.

retail-p08-s12.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p08-s12.text: You should at most make one tool call at a time, and if you take a tool call, you should not respond to the user at the same time.

retail-p08-s13.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p08-s13.text: If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.

retail-p09-s14.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p09-s14.text: You should deny user requests that are against this policy.
retail-p09-s14.note: [anaphora, reviewed] marked as instantiating, but the fires belong to the rules below

retail-p10-s15.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p10-s15.text: You should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions.

retail-p10-s16.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p10-s16.text: To transfer, first make a tool call to transfer_to_human_agents, and then send the message 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT.
retail-p10-s16.note: [clause_split, proposed] the literal transfer string; the iff is s15 and stays judge

retail-p10-s17.heading: Retail agent policy
retail-p10-s17.text: PLEASE HOLD ON.' to the user.
retail-p10-s17.note: [clause_split, proposed] the tail of the literal transfer string

retail-p11-s18.heading: Domain basic
retail-p11-s18.text: - All times in the database are EST and 24 hour based. For example "02:30:00" means 2:30 AM EST.

retail-p12-s19.heading: User
retail-p12-s19.text: Each user has a profile containing:

retail-p14-s24.heading: User
retail-p14-s24.text: There are three types of payment methods: **gift card**, **paypal account**, **credit card**.

retail-p15-s25.heading: Product
retail-p15-s25.text: Our retail store has 50 types of products.

retail-p16-s26.heading: Product
retail-p16-s26.text: For each **type of product**, there are **variant items** of different **options**.

retail-p17-s27.heading: Product
retail-p17-s27.text: For example, for a 't-shirt' product, there could be a variant item with option 'color blue size M', and another variant item with option 'color red size L'.

retail-p18-s28.heading: Product
retail-p18-s28.text: Each product has the following attributes:

retail-p20-s32.heading: Product
retail-p20-s32.text: Each variant item has the following attributes:

retail-p21-s34.heading: Product
retail-p21-s34.text: - information about the value of the product options for this item.

retail-p22-s37.heading: Product
retail-p22-s37.text: Note: Product ID and Item ID have no relations and should not be confused!

retail-p23-s38.heading: Order
retail-p23-s38.text: Each order has the following attributes:

retail-p24-s44.heading: Order
retail-p24-s44.text: - fullfilments info (tracking id and item ids)

retail-p25-s46.heading: Order
retail-p25-s46.text: The status of an order can be: **pending**, **processed**, **delivered**, or **cancelled**.

retail-p26-s47.heading: Order
retail-p26-s47.text: Orders can have other optional attributes based on the actions that have been taken (cancellation reason, which items have been exchanged, what was the exchane price difference etc)
retail-p26-s47.note: [anaphora, proposed] marked with an arrow but declares there is no rule

retail-p27-s48.heading: Generic action rules
retail-p27-s48.text: Generally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders.
retail-p27-s48.note: [anaphora, proposed] the generic statement of the per-action status rule, which is `status_precondition`

retail-p28-s49.heading: Generic action rules
retail-p28-s49.text: Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order.

retail-p28-s50.heading: Generic action rules
retail-p28-s50.text: Be sure that all items to be changed are collected into a list before making the tool call!!!
retail-p28-s50.note: [clause_split, reviewed] the block registers only the once-per-order cap, which is s49; the collect-items-into-a-list advice carries no tag

retail-p29-s51.heading: Cancel pending order
retail-p29-s51.text: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.

retail-p30-s52.heading: Cancel pending order
retail-p30-s52.text: The user needs to confirm the order id and the reason (either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') for cancellation.
retail-p30-s52.note: [clause_split, reviewed] one sentence carries the confirmation clause and the reason enum

retail-p31-s54.heading: Cancel pending order
retail-p31-s54.text: After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'cancelled', and the total will be refunded via the original payment method immediately if it is gift card, otherwise in 5 to 7 business days.

retail-p32-s55.heading: Modify pending order
retail-p32-s55.text: An order can only be modified if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.

retail-p33-s56.heading: Modify pending order
retail-p33-s56.text: For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.

retail-p34-s57.heading: Modify payment
retail-p34-s57.text: The user can only choose a single payment method different from the original payment method.

retail-p35-s58.heading: Modify payment
retail-p35-s58.text: If the user wants the modify the payment method to gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the total amount.

retail-p36-s59.heading: Modify payment
retail-p36-s59.text: After user confirmation, the order status will be kept as 'pending'.
retail-p36-s59.note: [aside, proposed] the block assigns 'effect'; the AAP-1 mention is an aside on the subordinate 'After user confirmation' clause, as in s54/s73/s80 whose blocks read 'effect.'

retail-p36-s60.heading: Modify payment
retail-p36-s60.text: The original payment method will be refunded immediately if it is a gift card, otherwise it will be refunded within 5 to 7 business days.
retail-p36-s60.note: [aside, proposed] the refund sentence carries no confirmation clause at all

retail-p37-s61.heading: Modify items
retail-p37-s61.text: This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'.
retail-p37-s61.note: block declares arm once_per_order, arm modify_items_lockout, aap1_not_run

retail-p37-s62.heading: Modify items
retail-p37-s62.text: The agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore.
retail-p37-s62.note: [clause_split, proposed] the lockout sentence; `once_per_order` caps exchange and modify-items per order and does not count cancel, so it cannot cover 'not be able to modify or cancel'. The 'once' clause is s61

retail-p37-s63.heading: Modify items
retail-p37-s63.text: So you must confirm all the details are correct and be cautious before taking this action.
retail-p37-s63.note: [clause_split, reviewed] "confirm all the details are correct ... before taking this action" is the consent clause, not the cap or the lockout

retail-p37-s64.heading: Modify items
retail-p37-s64.text: In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all the items they want to modify.
retail-p37-s64.note: [clause_split, reviewed] the remind-the-customer sentence, not `once_per_order` or `modify_items_lockout`

retail-p38-s65.heading: Modify items
retail-p38-s65.text: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
retail-p38-s65.note: [clause_split, proposed] same split as the reviewed retail-p46-s76, in Modify items rather than Exchange

retail-p38-s66.heading: Modify items
retail-p38-s66.text: There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.
retail-p38-s66.note: [clause_split, proposed] `new_item_differs` compares item id to new item id and fires only when they are identical, so it cannot check 'no change of product types'; that half is graded

retail-p39-s67.heading: Modify items
retail-p39-s67.text: The user must provide a payment method to pay or receive refund of the price difference.

retail-p39-s68.heading: Modify items
retail-p39-s68.text: If the user provides a gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the price difference.

retail-p40-s69.heading: Return delivered order
retail-p40-s69.text: An order can only be returned if its status is 'delivered', and you should check its status before taking the action.

retail-p41-s70.heading: Return delivered order
retail-p41-s70.text: The user needs to confirm the order id and the list of items to be returned.

retail-p42-s71.heading: Return delivered order
retail-p42-s71.text: The user needs to provide a payment method to receive the refund.
retail-p42-s71.note: [orphan, reviewed] no annotation block follows this paragraph; the mechanical default already yields untagged, recorded here to pin the expectation

retail-p43-s72.heading: Return delivered order
retail-p43-s72.text: The refund must either go to the original payment method, or an existing gift card.

retail-p44-s73.heading: Return delivered order
retail-p44-s73.text: After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'return requested', and the user will receive an email regarding how to return items.

retail-p45-s74.heading: Exchange delivered order
retail-p45-s74.text: An order can only be exchanged if its status is 'delivered', and you should check its status before taking the action.

retail-p45-s75.heading: Exchange delivered order
retail-p45-s75.text: In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all items to be exchanged.

retail-p46-s76.heading: Exchange delivered order
retail-p46-s76.text: For a delivered order, each item can be exchanged to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
retail-p46-s76.note: [clause_split, reviewed] the different-option half is the arm; the same-product half is graded

retail-p46-s77.heading: Exchange delivered order
retail-p46-s77.text: There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.
retail-p46-s77.note: [clause_split, proposed] as retail-p38-s66: the product-type sentence is outside what `new_item_differs` compares

retail-p47-s78.heading: Exchange delivered order
retail-p47-s78.text: The user must provide a payment method to pay or receive refund of the price difference.

retail-p47-s79.heading: Exchange delivered order
retail-p47-s79.text: If the user provides a gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the price difference.

retail-p48-s80.heading: Exchange delivered order
retail-p48-s80.text: After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'exchange requested', and the user will receive an email regarding how to return items.

retail-p48-s81.heading: Exchange delivered order
retail-p48-s81.text: There is no need to place a new order.

airline-p01-s01.heading: Airline Agent Policy
airline-p01-s01.note: [anaphora, proposed] an input to `cancel_eligibility` and `flown_no_cabin_change`, not a rule of its own

airline-p02-s02.heading: Airline Agent Policy
airline-p02-s02.text: As an airline agent, you can help users **book**, **modify**, or **cancel** flight reservations.
airline-p02-s02.note: [anaphora, proposed] tool inventory, as the retail capability list is

airline-p03-s04.heading: Airline Agent Policy
airline-p03-s04.text: Before taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.

airline-p04-s05.heading: Airline Agent Policy
airline-p04-s05.text: You should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.

airline-p05-s06.heading: Airline Agent Policy
airline-p05-s06.text: You should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously.

airline-p05-s07.heading: Airline Agent Policy
airline-p05-s07.text: If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.

airline-p06-s08.heading: Airline Agent Policy
airline-p06-s08.text: You should deny user requests that are against this policy.
airline-p06-s08.note: [anaphora, reviewed] the airline copy of the deny-out-of-policy rule

airline-p07-s09.heading: Airline Agent Policy
airline-p07-s09.text: You should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions.

airline-p07-s10.heading: Airline Agent Policy
airline-p07-s10.text: To transfer, first make a tool call to transfer_to_human_agents, and then send the message 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT.
airline-p07-s10.note: [clause_split, proposed] the literal transfer string; the iff is s09 and stays judge

airline-p07-s11.heading: Airline Agent Policy
airline-p07-s11.text: PLEASE HOLD ON.' to the user.
airline-p07-s11.note: [clause_split, proposed] the tail of the literal transfer string

airline-p08-s12.heading: User
airline-p08-s12.text: Each user has a profile containing:

airline-p09-s20.heading: User
airline-p09-s20.text: There are three types of payment methods: **credit card**, **gift card**, **travel certificate**.

airline-p11-s22.heading: Flight
airline-p11-s22.text: Each flight has the following attributes:

airline-p11-s26.heading: Flight
airline-p11-s26.text: - scheduled departure and arrival time (local time)

airline-p12-s27.heading: Flight
airline-p12-s27.text: A flight can be available at multiple dates.

airline-p12-s29.heading: Flight
airline-p12-s29.text: - If the status is **available**, the flight has not taken off, available seats and prices are listed.

airline-p12-s30.heading: Flight
airline-p12-s30.text: - If the status is **delayed** or **on time**, the flight has not taken off, cannot be booked.

airline-p12-s31.heading: Flight
airline-p12-s31.text: - If the status is **flying**, the flight has taken off but not landed, cannot be booked.

airline-p13-s32.heading: Flight
airline-p13-s32.text: There are three cabin classes: **basic economy**, **economy**, **business**. **basic economy** is its own class, completely distinct from **economy**.

airline-p14-s33.heading: Flight
airline-p14-s33.text: Seat availability and prices are listed for each cabin class.

airline-p16-s44.heading: Reservation
airline-p16-s44.text: There are two types of trip: **one way** and **round trip**.
airline-p16-s44.note: [anaphora, proposed] marked with an arrow but declares there is no rule

airline-p17-s45.heading: Book flight
airline-p17-s45.text: The agent must first obtain the user id from the user.

airline-p18-s46.heading: Book flight
airline-p18-s46.text: The agent should then ask for the trip type, origin, destination.

airline-p19-s48.heading: Book flight
airline-p19-s48.text: - Cabin class must be the same across all the flights in a reservation.

airline-p20-s50.heading: Book flight
airline-p20-s50.text: - Each reservation can have at most five passengers.

airline-p20-s51.heading: Book flight
airline-p20-s51.text: - The agent needs to collect the first name, last name, and date of birth for each passenger.

airline-p20-s52.heading: Book flight
airline-p20-s52.text: - All passengers must fly the same flights in the same cabin.

airline-p21-s54.heading: Book flight
airline-p21-s54.text: - Each reservation can use at most one travel certificate, at most one credit card, and at most three gift cards.

airline-p21-s55.heading: Book flight
airline-p21-s55.text: - The remaining amount of a travel certificate is not refundable.

airline-p21-s56.heading: Book flight
airline-p21-s56.text: - All payment methods must already be in user profile for safety reasons.

airline-p22-s58.heading: Book flight
airline-p22-s58.text: - If the booking user is a regular member:

airline-p22-s59.heading: Book flight
airline-p22-s59.text: - 0 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger

airline-p22-s60.heading: Book flight
airline-p22-s60.text: - 1 free checked bag for each economy passenger

airline-p22-s61.heading: Book flight
airline-p22-s61.text: - 2 free checked bags for each business passenger

airline-p22-s62.heading: Book flight
airline-p22-s62.text: - If the booking user is a silver member:

airline-p22-s63.heading: Book flight
airline-p22-s63.text: - 1 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger

airline-p22-s64.heading: Book flight
airline-p22-s64.text: - 2 free checked bag for each economy passenger

airline-p22-s65.heading: Book flight
airline-p22-s65.text: - 3 free checked bags for each business passenger

airline-p22-s66.heading: Book flight
airline-p22-s66.text: - If the booking user is a gold member:

airline-p22-s67.heading: Book flight
airline-p22-s67.text: - 2 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger

airline-p22-s68.heading: Book flight
airline-p22-s68.text: - 3 free checked bag for each economy passenger

airline-p22-s69.heading: Book flight
airline-p22-s69.text: - 4 free checked bags for each business passenger

airline-p23-s71.heading: Book flight
airline-p23-s71.text: Do not add checked bags that the user does not need.

airline-p24-s73.heading: Book flight
airline-p24-s73.text: - The agent should ask if the user wants to buy the travel insurance.
airline-p24-s73.note: [clause_split, proposed] the ask is this sentence; the graded price is s74

airline-p24-s74.heading: Book flight
airline-p24-s74.text: - The travel insurance is 30 dollars per passenger and enables full refund if the user needs to cancel the flight given health or weather reasons.

airline-p25-s75.heading: Modify flight
airline-p25-s75.text: First, the agent must obtain the user id and reservation id.
airline-p25-s75.note: block declares arm read_before_write, arm user_id_from_user

airline-p25-s76.heading: Modify flight
airline-p25-s76.text: - The user must provide their user id.
airline-p25-s76.note: [clause_split, proposed] `read_before_write` tests the reservation id against the reservations read and says nothing about the user id; this bullet is the user-id half

airline-p25-s77.heading: Modify flight
airline-p25-s77.text: - If the user doesn't know their reservation id, the agent should help locate it using available tools.
airline-p25-s77.note: [clause_split, proposed] `user_id_from_user` tests a user id against the user turns and says nothing about locating a reservation; this bullet is the read half

airline-p26-s79.heading: Modify flight
airline-p26-s79.text: - Basic economy flights cannot be modified.

airline-p26-s80.heading: Modify flight
airline-p26-s80.text: - Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.

airline-p26-s81.heading: Modify flight
airline-p26-s81.text: - Some flight segments can be kept, but their prices will not be updated based on the current price.

airline-p26-s82.heading: Modify flight
airline-p26-s82.text: - The API does not check these for the agent, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!

airline-p27-s83.heading: Modify flight
airline-p27-s83.note: [cross_reference, proposed] the `read_before_write` backtick explains what happens when the reservation was never read; that arm is registered on s75-s77

airline-p27-s84.heading: Modify flight
airline-p27-s84.text: - Cabin cannot be changed if any flight in the reservation has already been flown.
airline-p27-s84.note: [cross_reference, proposed] as s83: the cross-reference is not an instantiation

airline-p27-s85.heading: Modify flight
airline-p27-s85.text: - In other cases, all reservations, including basic economy, can change cabin without changing the flights.

airline-p27-s86.heading: Modify flight
airline-p27-s86.text: - Cabin class must remain the same across all the flights in the same reservation; changing cabin for just one flight segment is not possible.

airline-p27-s87.heading: Modify flight
airline-p27-s87.text: - If the price after cabin change is higher than the original price, the user is required to pay for the difference.

airline-p27-s88.heading: Modify flight
airline-p27-s88.text: - If the price after cabin change is lower than the original price, the user is should be refunded the difference.

airline-p28-s90.heading: Modify flight
airline-p28-s90.text: - The user can add but not remove checked bags.

airline-p28-s91.heading: Modify flight
airline-p28-s91.text: - The user cannot add insurance after initial booking.

airline-p29-s93.heading: Modify flight
airline-p29-s93.text: - The user can modify passengers but cannot modify the number of passengers.

airline-p29-s94.heading: Modify flight
airline-p29-s94.text: - Even a human agent cannot modify the number of passengers.

airline-p30-s96.heading: Modify flight
airline-p30-s96.text: - If the flights are changed, the user needs to provide a single gift card or credit card for payment or refund method. The payment method must already be in user profile for safety reasons.
airline-p30-s96.note: [clause_split, reviewed] one bullet carries the profile-membership rule and the payment-composition count

airline-p31-s97.heading: Cancel flight
airline-p31-s97.text: First, the agent must obtain the user id and reservation id.
airline-p31-s97.note: block declares arm read_before_write, arm user_id_from_user

airline-p31-s98.heading: Cancel flight
airline-p31-s98.text: - The user must provide their user id.
airline-p31-s98.note: [clause_split, proposed] the Cancel-flight copy of airline-p25-s76

airline-p31-s99.heading: Cancel flight
airline-p31-s99.text: - If the user doesn't know their reservation id, the agent should help locate it using available tools.
airline-p31-s99.note: [clause_split, proposed] the Cancel-flight copy of airline-p25-s77

airline-p32-s100.heading: Cancel flight
airline-p32-s100.text: The agent must also obtain the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)

airline-p33-s101.heading: Cancel flight
airline-p33-s101.text: If any portion of the flight has already been flown, the agent cannot help and transfer is needed.

airline-p34-s102.heading: Cancel flight
airline-p34-s102.text: Otherwise, flight can be cancelled if any of the following is true:

airline-p34-s103.heading: Cancel flight
airline-p34-s103.text: - The booking was made within the last 24 hrs

airline-p34-s104.heading: Cancel flight
airline-p34-s104.text: - The flight is cancelled by airline

airline-p34-s106.heading: Cancel flight
airline-p34-s106.text: - The user has travel insurance and the reason for cancellation is covered by insurance.

airline-p35-s107.heading: Cancel flight
airline-p35-s107.text: The API does not check that cancellation rules are met, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!

airline-p36-s109.heading: Cancel flight
airline-p36-s109.text: - The refund will go to original payment methods within 5 to 7 business days.

airline-p37-s110.heading: Refunds and Compensation
airline-p37-s110.text: Do not proactively offer a compensation unless the user explicitly asks for one.

airline-p38-s111.heading: Refunds and Compensation
airline-p38-s111.text: Do not compensate if the user is regular member and has no travel insurance and flies (basic) economy.

airline-p39-s112.heading: Refunds and Compensation
airline-p39-s112.text: Always confirms the facts before offering compensation.

airline-p40-s113.heading: Refunds and Compensation
airline-p40-s113.text: Only compensate if the user is a silver/gold member or has travel insurance or flies business.
airline-p40-s113.note: [anaphora, proposed] the line above registers `certificate_eligibility`; promises.py emits that arm through `checks`, so its predicate is AAP-2/scope and the block's 'AAP-3' is a slip

airline-p41-s114.heading: Refunds and Compensation
airline-p41-s114.text: - If the user complains about cancelled flights in a reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts, with the amount being $100 times the number of passengers.
airline-p41-s114.note: [attachment, proposed] a blank line between the two certificate bullets attaches the block to s115 alone; the $100 multiplier the arm accepts appears only here. The only orphaned rule sentence in either policy -- every other paragraph without a block is domain description

airline-p42-s115.heading: Refunds and Compensation
airline-p42-s115.text: - If the user complains about delayed flights in a reservation and wants to change or cancel the reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts and changing or cancelling the reservation, with the amount being $50 times the number of passengers.

airline-p43-s116.heading: Refunds and Compensation
airline-p43-s116.text: Do not offer compensation for any other reason than the ones listed above.
